body:
Review read of head `274ca1483` (read-only Opus agent that did not write the change, nothing built). The review comment with the marker follows after the trial merge on the current main.

**Result of the read: no blocker.**

- **Safety.** `flute_law::name_first` only inserts at index 0. It removes nothing. `blocks_post()` is false for `FluteShort` only. Each post gate decides with `any(blocks_post)` or `filter(blocks_post)`, so the order of the list changes no verdict. No code reads `warnings[0]`.
- **Placement.** The call is only in the upright arm. Only `Pocket`, `Adaptive2D`, `Offset2D` and `Contour` are judged. A flute of 0, a negative, NaN or infinite flute gives no note and no panic.
- **Project file.** `Warning` is saved in the path cache. The new variant is additive, as `StrategyFallback` was (#3035).
- **Tests.** `mcp_verify` still pins `ok` false, `held_by` and the refused post. No `#[test]` is removed. The heavy test has a heavy-lane ignore reason.
- **Merge.** `git merge-tree` with main `edcbfe4dd` is clean.

Notes, none is a blocker. I file them as `P7` follow-ups:

1. The depth is measured from the top of the raw setup stock. After an earlier operation that lowers the top, the note can state a depth that is too large.
2. The warning says "the findings after this one name the moves where it meets material". The findings after it can also be `RapidInStock` or `Gouge`.
3. The texts are in mm also in an inch document.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 274ca14832ff72ca46d8f8316558ecf375581088 -->
**Review of head `274ca1483`: clean. No blocker.** The read is in the comment above (a read-only Opus agent that did not write the change). This comment adds the trial merge.

Trial merge `133bd20e7` (not pushed; parents: main `b5ef7c39e` and this head; the merge is clean). A gate-runner that did not write the change ran it. All steps are green:

- `camcraft-sim`, whole crate: 847 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` lib: 298 passed.
- App binaries: `flute_reach` 3 (1 ignored, heavy lane), `mcp_verify` 3, `tool_body_beside_shank` 5 (it holds the `t31` test: the clean program still has no finding after #3487), `strategy_fallback` 1, `shoulder_adaptive` 7, `golden_cl` 33, `conformance` 7, the three `example_catalog` suites, `first_part_programs` 2; 0 failed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib: 1481 passed, 0 failed.
- clippy with `-D warnings` on `camcraft-sim --all-targets`, `camcraft-app --lib`, `camcraft-ui --all-targets`: clean.
- One release step: `flute_reach` with `--include-ignored`: 4 passed.

No golden and no catalog program moved. No heavy lane ran (`P3`; the heavy lanes run at the cut). The follow-up is #3600.

The merge waits for the post-merge run of main `35e3bd173` (the fix for #3602), and it follows #3595, which changes the same module directory.

Trial merge on the current main, with #3595 in it (merge `a323c47ce`, not pushed; parents: main `9a7de3781` and head `274ca1483`; clean): `camcraft-sim` 852 passed, 0 failed; app `flute_reach` 3, `mcp_verify` 3, `tool_body_beside_shank` 5, `strategy_fallback` 1, `golden_cl` 33, `first_part_programs` 2, 0 failed; clippy on `camcraft-sim --all-targets` and `camcraft-app --lib` is clean. The review above stays valid for this head. The merge waits for the green post-merge run of `35e3bd173`.

Merge note. Class: no refresh (head `274ca1483` merged unchanged as `e8fc84062`). Basis: the review with the marker on this head, and the trial merge on main `9a7de3781` (all green). Main was green (post-merge run of `35e3bd173`).
